issues: Broken: on the desktop homepage (both brands) everything below the USP/story titles was blank (USPs, story text and image, stats, CTA copy, contact, footer) because reveal-on-scroll kept .rv elements at opacity 0 until an IntersectionObserver fired. On mobile the CTA band was an empty blue slab with an orphaned button.
The same reveal mechanism hid product cards in the catalog whenever the observer did not fire.
A brand with few products (BOHLT, 3) left half of the strict 6-up row empty, so the giant-type/small-goods tension turned into a hole.
The categories section label repeated the products title word for word ('Onze droogijsproducten' twice in a row).
Dead air: about 150px of section padding stacked on the hero-sub bottom padding pushed the first products far below the fold.
Scores: creativity 7, typography 8, layout 5 (holes), polish 4 (blank sections), brand-colour robustness 7, mobile 6, generic-ness 7 (not generic).
fixed: Rewrote the reveal in both template.html and catalog.html: content is visible by default. Only elements that genuinely scroll in from the bottom edge play a keyframe fade-up, and nothing animates after a viewport resize, so captures and no-observer cases always show content.
Card pop/filter replay now clears the reveal animation class so the two animations don't fight.

Added a closing 'shop all' tile that spans the rest of the last product row (or becomes a full-width black strip when the row is full). Its variable display word swells from wght 200 to 950 on hover, and the tile turns --c-primary.
Categories section now has its own label ('N categorieën' plus the brand name) instead of duplicating the products title.
Tightened the gap between the hero and the first product section so the 6-up row of small objects sits right under the giant wordmark.
